selection.rule: Per layer, maximal positive discovery reduction in A-versus-E paired log-odds response; controls are minima. This selects candidates, not a validated circuit.

protocol.intervention: First-layer pre-projection head output exchange/restoration within each unchanged input; restore zeros the head everywhere else and uses no scale.
protocol.predicted_swap: Swap A-successor and D-successor site outputs: A clean should move B/C odds downward, A counterfactual upward; D should reverse these directions. E is a neutral query control.
protocol.predicted_restoration: Restoring only the two successor-site outputs after head deletion should recover part of the query-specific response; restoring context sites is a control.
protocol.controls: Context-site swap and restoration, same-site self patch, and successor-site swaps in the other three first-layer heads. Context-site controls are off the hypothesized path, not asserted to be universally irrelevant.
protocol.precision: Float64 computation of unchanged float32-trained parameters; original forward independently certified in the frozen discovery/confirmation runner.
protocol.scope: Fresh controlled follow-up after discovery and initial confirmation. No natural-source or sequence-time experiment; not an isolated downstream K-only intervention.

averaging: Within each family, average probability of B after clean A and of C after counterfactual A; exchange these labels for the other successor. Then average all 1,024 independent family values equally.
uncertainty: 95% Student-t intervals for the mean across 1,024 independent probe families (1023 degrees of freedom). Each family's paired prompts stay together. Paired intervention changes are also reported.
intervention: Visible input is unchanged within each intervention. Swap the L1H2 pre-projection output vectors at the two demonstrated successor positions; preserve all other head outputs.
restoration_note: Restoring only the two successor-site outputs while zeroing this head elsewhere overshoots the intact response. Its full result is retained, without interpreting it as a recovered fraction.
scope: Causal evidence for a copying-related computation on these controlled prompts in one fixed transformer. The intervention can change both downstream keys and values; it does not isolate a key-only circuit or establish natural-source prevalence or sequence-time emergence.
